_readme: New engine (Dashboard/brain_host, started by Dashboard/server.js): the brain characters run swarm.js in the dashboard; their L2Swarm accounts run Scripts/agent2.js only. "allowAll": true = every character of swarm.config.json (+ "allow", minus "except"). Switch back: "on": false, or "allowAll": false + the characters in "allow". Move running accounts: dashboard PC tab -> New engine, or node docs/plan/tools/attach_agent.js --all --apply (back: --back --names A,B --apply). docs/plan/INSTALL.md section "New engine".
